name: Ring of Elemental Attraction
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 15th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of elemental command. While the ring functions as the ring it appears to be, this ring is also attuned to a specific energy type as outlined in the chart below. All attacks of the specified type made within 50 feet of the wearer target the wearer instead of the intended target, including energy-based attacks made by the wearer.

Elemental Type	Energy Type
Air	Electricity
Earth	Acid
Fire	Fire
Water	Cold

Additionally, if the wearer is involved in combat with an elemental of the type to which the ring is attuned, the elemental will attack the wearer if it can do so without unnecessary risk.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of endure elements followed by a remove curse upon it. Doing so destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of elemental command

Identification DC 40
False Identification DC 30
